name: Ralph Barclay Braun Memorial Scholarship (SCU Marine Science Honours)
summary: $5,000 for a full-time Bachelor of Science with Honours student based at the National Marine Science Centre, Coffs Harbour.
who: Formal offer to the Bachelor of Science with Honours.
Based full-time and on campus at the National Marine Science Centre.
GPA above 5.5 in the final undergraduate year.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with your record, a 100-word statement and a one-page research proposal.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Ralph Barclay Braun Memorial Scholarship

evidence.quote: Students must be based, full-time, at the National Marine Science Centre (NMSC).
